User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want to see total revenue on the dashboard, so that I understand overall financial performance.
Description: Day 4 emphasized executive visibility. The dashboard must display aggregated revenue across all products and regions in real time.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Display total revenue with selectable date range.
2. Allow Month-to-Date and Year-to-Date filters.
3. Pull data from finalized invoices only.
4. Refresh within 5-minute cache window.
5. Match accounting totals exactly.
Notes: Revenue must reconcile with accounting system to maintain executive trust.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want average margin displayed, so that I can monitor profitability trends.
Description: Margin KPI must align with Day 2 margin engine calculations.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Calculate using stored margin snapshots.
2. Support date filters.
3. Exclude incomplete vendor cost records.
4. Highlight margin below target.
5. Allow drill-down to quote level.
Notes: Must use snapshot logic, not recalculated values.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want a widget showing pending approvals, so that pricing decisions are not delayed.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Show count of pending approvals.
2. Filter by region or manager.
3. Link directly to quote.
4. Update in real time.
5. Highlight severe margin deviations.

User Story: As a Director, I want to track how long approvals remain pending, so that delays are addressed quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Record approval request timestamp.
2. Calculate elapsed time.
3. Highlight approvals older than threshold.
4. Include aging in dashboard report.
5. Allow sorting by aging duration.

User Story: As an Account Manager (AM), I want to see active site count, so that I understand customer footprint.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Count active sites only.
2. Allow filtering by region.
3. Update when site status changes.
4. Drill-down capability.
5. Exportable data.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want recurring revenue shown separately, so that predictable revenue is visible.
Description: Recurring revenue must be tracked independently.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Include only recurring products.
2. Support date filtering.
3. Exclude canceled products.
4. Compare month-over-month growth.
5. Match billing engine totals.

User Story: As a Billing Specialist, I want declined payment alerts visible, so that I can follow up immediately.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Display count of declined transactions.
2. Show customer name and amount.
3. Provide link to billing record.
4. Update instantly when decline occurs.
5. Log follow-up action.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want to see quote conversion rate, so that sales performance is measurable.
Description: Conversion rate tracks effectiveness of quoting.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Calculate finalized quotes divided by drafts.
2. Filter by user.
3. Filter by product line.
4. Display percentage and trend.
5. Export to CSV.

User Story: As a Director, I want margin variance reports, so that deviations from approved pricing are visible.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Compare approved margin vs final margin.
2. Highlight variance above threshold.
3. Allow drill-down.
4. Support date filters.
5. Exportable format.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want intake duration tracked, so that efficiency is measurable.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Calculate average intake time.
2. Exclude abandoned drafts.
3. Filter by user.
4. Compare weekly averages.
5. Export report.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want real-time low margin alerts, so that action can be taken quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Trigger alert when margin below threshold.
2. Display on dashboard.
3. Allow direct navigation to quote.
4. Auto-dismiss after resolution.
5. Log notification.

User Story: As an Operations Manager, I want alerts for upcoming removals, so that scheduling is proactive.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Trigger alert 48 hours before removal.
2. Display on dashboard.
3. Filter by region.
4. Mark as acknowledged.
5. Log notification.

User Story: As a Director, I want revenue broken down by product line, so that performance trends are visible.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Group revenue by product line.
2. Allow date filter.
3. Display percentage share.
4. Drill-down capability.
5. Exportable report.

User Story: As an Executive, I want revenue segmented by region, so that geographic performance is clear.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Aggregate by region.
2. Filter by product.
3. Show margin by region.
4. Export report.
5. Display trend over time.

User Story: As an Administrator (Admin), I want dashboard widgets restricted by role, so that users see only relevant data.
Description: Sensitive financial data must be protected.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Role-based widget visibility.
2. Hide margin for non-finance roles.
3. Log permission changes.
4. Block direct URL access.
5. Configurable per role.

User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want to export dashboard data, so that I can share reports externally.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Export filtered view.
2. Preserve column order.
3. Include date range header.
4. Respect role-based visibility.
5. Log export action.

User Story: As a Director, I want trend charts over time, so that growth patterns are visible.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Show line chart by month.
2. Support custom date range.
3. Compare revenue vs margin.
4. Hover tooltips for values.
5. Export chart image.

User Story: As an Administrator (Admin), I want system error alerts visible, so that technical issues are identified quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Display recent system errors.
2. Show severity level.
3. Timestamp included.
4. Link to logs.
5. Auto-expire resolved alerts.

User Story: As an Administrator (Admin), I want user activity summary visible, so that auditing is simplified.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Show recent login events.
2. Show pricing edits.
3. Filter by user.
4. Exportable.
5. Maintain 90-day retention.

Task Name: Allow Users to Save Custom Reports
User Story: As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), I want to save custom report views, so that I can reuse filters without rebuilding queries.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Save filter configuration.
2. Name saved report.
3. Share with team.
4. Edit saved filters.
5. Delete saved report.
